responsibility: Defines the core graph abstraction traits used across rustc_data_structures and exposes module-level graph utilities, including reachable-cycle detection and wrappers for directed or undirected-style depth-first traversal built on those traits.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the umbrella graph surface: it defines the core graph traits and a few lightweight graph-wide helpers, whereas the sibling `graph/*/mod.rs` files either implement specific graph representations or specialized analyses on top of those traits.
